name: Steele-Reese Foundation Idaho and Montana Grant Program (Rural Conservation)
summary: Foundation grants for locally focused land, water and wildlife conservation and ecosystem protection in rural Idaho and Montana and Native nations there, applied for through a letter of inquiry.

status.quote: We received 100 LOIs before January 18, 2026, closed the process on that date

opens.quote: We will open the LOI process on January 12, 2026.

geography.quote: makes grants only to federally tax-exempt entities for work in rural Idaho and Montana communities

access.quote: the application process begins with a Letter of Inquiry (LOI) that must be submitted via the Foundation's online grant portal.

window.quote: We will open the LOI process on January 12, 2026. We will close it once we have received 100 LOIs, which may be within days.

applicant_types.quote: The Steele-Reese Foundation makes grants only to federally tax-exempt entities
